blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Malacañang on Tuesday maintained that there should be no special treatment for former Speaker Martin Romualdez following his transfer to the New Quezon City Jail in Barangay Payatas. Romualdez was transferred from the Philippine General Hospital (PGH) on Monday evening pursuant to an order from the Sandiganbayan Third Division. He had been confined at the state-run hospital over the weekend. READ: Romualdez now behind bars The order came after PGH specialists determined that Romualdez was medically stable and could be discharged at any time, following an examination by a dozen specialists at the hospital.
